concepts.title: A · Z-Faltung
concepts.imageGenPrompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone graphic design exploration for an independent Rudolstadt Festival companion, NOT a finished app icon. Create ONE exceptional, professionally art-directed flat vector-style graphic of a folded festival map/programme. The user likes the folded-plan idea but rejects the crude generic booklet geometry of previous attempts. Explore a convincing and elegant map silhouette, authentic paper-fold construction and strong graphic hierarchy. Input 1 is the original stacked festival wordmark and the strict reference for the actual narrow, slightly irregular lowercase letterforms. Input 2 is the earlier icon solely to explain the general starting concept; remove its app-icon background, glass, bevels, lighting and primitive book-like construction completely. Preserve the original typography from input 1; the exact visible text must be 'rudol' on the first line and 'stadt' on the second, INCLUDING THE L in rudol; do not replace it with a generic sans-serif or invent a new typeface. The wordmark is printed flat, subordinate to the designed map object, never extruded. Color vocabulary: crisp warm white, rich aubergine purple, muted copper orange, at most one pale lavender plane tone. Broad solid color areas, clean vector-like edges. No textures, grain, distress, gradients, shadows, gloss, glass, plastic, outlines around letters, cartoon stroke, photos, physical mockup, icon tile, squircle, rounded-square frame, background panel, captions, extra text, year or fake UI. This is graphic artwork alone on a genuinely transparent background, with generous clear margin. A very fine plum contour can distinguish white outer edges; no heavy outline. Routes are meaningful restrained printed linework with a few stops, not arbitrary zigzags. Favor deliberate planar construction and refined proportions over detail. DIRECTION A: a genuine continuous three-panel accordion/Z-fold festival map seen from a lightly elevated frontal viewpoint. One broad front-left white cover with the authentic plum stacked wordmark, a narrow receding aubergine middle valley, and a copper right panel opening outward carrying a very spare cream route with three clear stops. All panels physically connect at the two continuous alternating creases. The top and bottom edges must form a coherent elegant shallow zigzag, making this read instantly as a map rather than an open book or two detached rectangles. Use sharp, precise paper corners and a compact broad silhouette. Do not add a bookmark or pin. The print and folding geometry should make a beautiful graphic mark even without materials.

imageGenRefinementPrompt: Edit only the graphic finish of this exact existing festival map design. Preserve the panel geometry, silhouette, fold construction, placement of every route and stop, the bookmark if present, and especially every letter of the existing 'rudol' / 'stadt' lettering. Do not redraw, restyle or retype the lettering. Convert the entire illustration to a strictly FLAT vector-style graphic: one constant solid color per panel, solid single-color lettering and routes. Remove ALL external shadows, glows, fog, halo, feathered edges, vignette and background haze. Outside the actual sheet/ribbon/route shapes the alpha MUST be completely zero; only clean edge antialiasing may remain. Remove ALL gradients, specular highlights, paper texture, noise and lighting inside the shapes. Keep fine plum boundary lines if present. Preserve crisp white, aubergine, muted copper and lavender as applicable, using the existing dominant hue of each panel. No icon background, no squircle, no mockup. This is plain graphic source artwork for judging shape and composition before building any final app icon.
